answer_4.quote: Finally, the authors of this work manually examine every question from both the inline-citation and author-written subsets and annotate these for specificity and quality
answer_4.guideline: Annotation rubrics for specificity and quality (Table 1): Specificity 0 (Broad: no more than 20 papers fit) or 1 (Specific: no more than 5 papers fit); Quality 0 (Discarded: factually wrong, unrealistic, overly broad/specific, or too easy), 1 (Acceptable: somewhat out of distribution or relatively easy), 2 (Good: challenging and meaningful).
